LanguageData.LP_Subdued.label: subdue
LanguageData.LP_Subdued.description: Dazed by a subduing weapon or slumber magic. This isn't a wound: no bleeding, no infection, no treatment needed, and painkillers don't help. At 100% severity they collapse unconscious (consciousness at most 10%, never fatal). Doesn't fade for 1 hour after the last subduing damage, then drops 10% per hour. Real wounds from other sources are calculated by vanilla rules as usual.
LanguageData.LP_Subdued.stages.0.label: dazed
LanguageData.LP_Subdued.stages.1.label: tottering
LanguageData.LP_Subdued.stages.2.label: about to collapse
LanguageData.LP_Subdued.stages.3.label: knocked out
LanguageData.LP_Netted.label: netted
LanguageData.LP_Netted.description: Hands and feet tangled in a binding net, moving -50%. Can break free in a few seconds.
